verdict.rationale: PayPal's developer docs let users explore REST API descriptions, generate client code, and import OpenAPI specs (paypal-docs-54, paypal-docs-16), and Braintree offers an explicit in-browser 'API Explorer for testing queries' with runnable GraphQL examples (paypal-supp-braintree-graphql). However, there's no clear evidence of a unified, interactive 'try it now' console with runnable examples across PayPal's main REST API reference itself. missing for 10: direct evidence of an in-docs runnable/try-it console for the core PayPal REST APIs (not just Braintree GraphQL), and independent/hands-on confirmation of this interactivity.
